th.style: background:#f1f3f5; border-bottom:1.5px solid #333333; padding:10px 14px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#111827; text-align:left;

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

td.b: UC-03: Deploy to Isolated Sandbox Runtime

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;
width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. Valid build plan produced by UC-02.
2. Version has been approved by Owner/Approver (or approval policy is bypassed).

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. System renders Jinja2 Dockerfile and auto-rewrites 127.0.0.1 bindings to 0.0.0.0.
2. Docker daemon builds container image, streaming layer output to build log.
3. Container is launched under strict resource caps (256 MB RAM, 0.5 CPU) with egress allowlist.
4. Readiness probe continuously tests the published port via TCP handshake.
5. Upon successful handshake, version status is marked live and routed through reverse proxy.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
Success: Application container running; reverse proxy serves app at /proxy/{id}.
Failure: Container stopped and cleaned up; status set to failed with build logs attached.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
2a. Container image build fails: Compilation halted and errors saved to build log.
4a. Application fails TCP probe before timeout: Marked failed; crash logs attached.
